    MAKE YOURSELF AT HOME

    One step is all it takes.

    An algorithm is just a set of steps for solving a problem. Here, you can watch those steps and see why they work.

    1. Pick an idea from the library.
    2. Change the input above the picture. In graph lessons, add or remove nodes and edges, then drag nodes into place.
    3. Press Watch it happen, or use Next to go at your own pace.
    4. Read the sentence below the picture. It explains the current move.
